title: Stripe Payments
description: Your Stripe keys. Add a webhook endpoint in the Stripe dashboard that points at /commerce/webhook/stripe on this site, then switch Stripe on in Settings → Commerce.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Test mode takes no real money: use it with Stripe's test cards until your store works end to end. Live mode charges real cards.

testPublishableKey.label: Test Publishable Key
testPublishableKey.help: Starts with pk_test_. Needed only when your store takes payment on its own page (Settings → Commerce → Checkout). Without it the buyer pays on Stripe's page. It is the one Stripe key a web page may hold: it lets the page show Stripe's form and nothing else.

testSecretKey.label: Test Secret Key
testSecretKey.help: Starts with sk_test_. From the Stripe dashboard, under Developers → API keys, with test mode on.

testWebhookSecret.label: Test Webhook Signing Secret
testWebhookSecret.help: Starts with whsec_. Shown when you add the webhook endpoint in test mode. Stripe signs every event with it, and an event without a good signature is refused.

livePublishableKey.label: Live Publishable Key
livePublishableKey.help: Starts with pk_live_. Needed only when your store takes payment on its own page (Settings → Commerce → Checkout). Without it the buyer pays on Stripe's page. It is the one Stripe key a web page may hold.

liveSecretKey.label: Live Secret Key
liveSecretKey.help: Starts with sk_live_. A restricted key (rk_live_) works too, if it may write Checkout Sessions and Refunds.

liveWebhookSecret.label: Live Webhook Signing Secret
liveWebhookSecret.help: Starts with whsec_. The live endpoint has its own secret, different from the test one.

statementDescriptor.label: Statement Descriptor Suffix
statementDescriptor.help: Optional. A short name added after your Stripe account's own on the buyer's card statement, such as your store's name. Up to 22 letters, digits and spaces.

taxBehavior.label: Stripe Tax: Your Prices
taxBehavior.help: Used only when Settings → Commerce → Tax is set to Worked out by the payment provider. Tax is added on top charges the buyer your price plus the tax, as is usual in the United States and Canada. Prices include tax charges your price and counts the tax as part of it, as is usual in Europe.
